description: AMGeO combines heterogeneous geospace observations to reconstruct high-latitude electrodynamics. The platform connects data preparation, open-source analysis software and web services for space-weather research. The resource is documented by University of Colorado, Boulder. The documented physical domain is High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The workflow requires access to external observation services, including AMGeO and OMNIWeb. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
